chore(release): publish SDK packages (#5278)

<!-- sdk-release-note-exempt: This release PR applies previously
reviewed SDK changes and only updates release metadata and generated
documentation. -->

A stable release: npm moves `latest` to these versions.

## What gets released

| Package | Version | Bump | Changesets |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `@composio/core` | 0.28.0 → **0.29.0** | minor |
`composio-client-update`, `custom-toolkit-mcp-url`,
`local-tools-rename`, `sdk-rate-limit-handling` |
| Python SDK (`composio` and every provider) | 0.31.0 → **0.32.0** |
minor | `python-client-2-1-0`, `python-local-tools-rename`,
`python-missing-api-key-message`, `python-rate-limit-handling` |
| `@composio/slim` | 0.28.0 → **0.29.0** | minor |
`custom-toolkit-mcp-url`, `local-tools-rename` |

## Changesets consumed

- `.changeset/composio-client-update.md` (`@composio/core` patch):
Update @composio/client to 2.1.0 to include the latest API changes.
- `.changeset/custom-toolkit-mcp-url.md` (`@composio/core` minor,
`@composio/slim` minor): Breaking \(experimental API\):
\`composio.experimental.customToolkits.create\(\)\` and \`upsert\(\)\`
take the MCP server URL as \`mcpUrl\` instead of \`appUrl\`, and send it
to the API as \`mcp\_url\`.
- `.changeset/local-tools-rename.md` (`@composio/core` minor,
`@composio/slim` minor): Renames in-process custom tools to local tools,
so they are no longer confused with the server-side custom toolkits on
\`composio.experimental.customToolkits\`. Pass
\`experimental.localTools\` and \`expe…
- `.changeset/python-client-2-1-0.md` (Python SDK (`composio` and every
provider) minor): Update \`composio-client\` to 2.1.0. Breaking
\(experimental API\):
\`composio.experimental.custom\_toolkits.create\(\)\` and \`upsert\(\)\`
take the MCP server URL as \`mcp\_url\` instead of \`app\_url\`.
- `.changeset/python-local-tools-rename.md` (Python SDK (`composio` and
every provider) minor): Renames in-process custom tools to local tools,
so they are no longer confused with the server-side custom toolkits on
\`composio.experimental.custom\_toolkits\`. Pass
\`experimental={"local\_tools": ...,…
- `.changeset/python-missing-api-key-message.md` (Python SDK (`composio`
and every provider) patch): The error for a missing API key now explains
how to set \`COMPOSIO\_API\_KEY\` or pass \`api\_key=\`, and links to
where to get a project API key, instead of suggesting \`composio
login\`, which the Python pa…
- `.changeset/python-rate-limit-handling.md` (Python SDK (`composio` and
every provider) minor): \`wait\_for\_connection\(\)\` handles rate
limits: the delay between polls grows from 1 to 5 seconds, and a poll
rejected with a 429 waits as long as its \`Retry-After\` header asks
\(up to the timeout\) and p…
- `.changeset/sdk-rate-limit-handling.md` (`@composio/core` minor):
Handle rate limits better: \`tools.execute\(\)\` reuses tool schemas
instead of fetching one per call, \`waitForConnection\(\)\` backs off
between polls and waits out a 429, and tool fetches and executions r…

## Changelog and docs edits

- Docs changelog entry:
[`docs/content/changelog/11-09-26-sdk-42589989280.mdx`](https://github.com/ComposioHQ/composio/blob/sdk-release/batch-42589989280/docs/content/changelog/11-09-26-sdk-42589989280.mdx).
- Package changelogs:
[`python/CHANGELOG.md`](https://github.com/ComposioHQ/composio/blob/sdk-release/batch-42589989280/python/CHANGELOG.md),
[`ts/packages/core/CHANGELOG.md`](https://github.com/ComposioHQ/composio/blob/sdk-release/batch-42589989280/ts/packages/core/CHANGELOG.md),
[`ts/packages/slim/CHANGELOG.md`](https://github.com/ComposioHQ/composio/blob/sdk-release/batch-42589989280/ts/packages/slim/CHANGELOG.md).
- Regenerated API references:
[`docs/content/reference/sdk-reference/python/`](https://github.com/ComposioHQ/composio/tree/sdk-release/batch-42589989280/docs/content/reference/sdk-reference/python/),
[`docs/content/reference/sdk-reference/typescript/`](https://github.com/ComposioHQ/composio/tree/sdk-release/batch-42589989280/docs/content/reference/sdk-reference/typescript/).

## How this ships

1. Release source is frozen at f22ab26848dbcc600131fb0b1d7261ab576ebb48.
Later `next` commits and their changesets wait for the next release.
2. Review the diff and approve this head. Approval must come from a
writer other than the requester (@jkomyno). Do not push to this branch:
the tag step only accepts the release bot's commit. To change the notes,
fix the changesets on `next`, close this PR and request a new release.
3. After approval and green checks, merge this PR. The release workflow
rechecks the approval and tags this exact head
`sdk-release/42589989280`; if the check fails, it creates no tag and
asks you to revert this PR and request the release again.
4. The tag run publishes the exact files the `SDK candidate` checks
built and the `SDK candidate smoke` checks installed on this PR. If a
publish job fails, use "Re-run failed jobs" on that run.
5. After publishing, the bot opens a docs PR that pins the released npm
versions, so twoslash checks the docs against them.
